title: Fiona Govan joined the slowest group on a Greek swimming holiday, and booked another

posts.facebook:
Flippers, a snorkel and tangerine caps: Fiona Govan swam about 4 km a day around Greek islands, at the back.

Fiona Govan marked her 50th birthday with a guided swimming holiday from Sivota, in western Greece, swimming about 4 km a day in the slowest group. What a swimming holiday is, what the NHS and RNLI say about swimming and open water, and how to work up to one from the pool or the lake.

A trip built around something you are not yet good at can teach you faster than training alone.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/travel/fiona-govan-greek-swimming-holiday/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
